title: Integration against a measure represented as θ·H^n⌞M on Borel sets, for integrands vanishing off a Borel set
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (M K : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ h : Euclidean N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → MeasurableSet K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n] → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ y in B ∩ M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ z, z ∉ K → h z = 0) → ∫ z, h z ∂μ = ∫ z in M, h z * θ z ∂μHE[n]
